answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can make every vertex post a refundable stake before it can trade. Like a lotus that only opens after paying sunlight, an identity earns the right to transact by locking funds that are slashed on fraud. Spawning a thousand fakes then costs a thousand stakes, while honest agents keep the nectar of their bond intact and withdraw it later. Forgery becomes a capital expense, not a free copy.
